notes.ratchet: Every limit is what the newest honesty round achieves, with no slack. Each file or transmission it still gets wrong is a named exception below. An exception that no longer occurs fails the run: remove it, so the limits only tighten.
notes.capture: The capture limits and the capture exception are calibrated on the reference labelled capture set (18 ten-second captures of one land-mobile band, run as one session). Another capture set needs its own file (--thresholds). A capture exception matches by kind and label only: pinning its channel would put a real frequency in this public file.
notes.digital-voice: The dv limits score the digital voice scenes (truth-dv.ts) on provisional, modelled line timings (scripts/fixtures/dv-latency-seeds.mjs): 19 DMR overs. Today's adapter starts a call at its first decoded embedded LC (head cut p90 727 ms) and ends it 40 ms after key-down at p90 (the line latency); one busy slot splits the other's call (2), hang-time idles merge the two overs of the repeater scene without a terminator into one call (2), and no call has a recording (19). Ratchet: lower them as the lifecycle improves; rerun when the in-image baseline replaces the seeds.
notes.digital-voice-missed: dvMissed 2: in direct mode the first decoded embedded LC comes too late for a call to overlap the 0.5 s over, and the 1 s over without a terminator, by min(200 ms, half the over), so both count as missed even when a short call is attributed to them.
notes.digital-voice-gaps: dvRecordingMissing is a phase-1 placeholder: the DV scenes give the adapter no recording directory, so every clear over counts as missing until they do. Encrypted overs are not covered yet: every scene sends clear voice.

exceptions.name: fresh-pager-twin
exceptions.label: pocsag
exceptions.reason: The first message on a pager channel that reads analog FM, before any decode: the channel holds no digital prior yet, and its replay decode lands after the file finished. Its later messages are refused.

exceptions.name: fresh-pager-busy
exceptions.label: pocsag
exceptions.reason: The same first message on a busy band (the replay queue is behind): no prior yet. Later messages are held provisional and discarded when their late decode lands.

exceptions.name: fresh-dmr-handheld-busy
exceptions.label: dmr
exceptions.reason: A DMR handheld's first over on a busy band, recorded before its channel has the 4 TDMA votes or a decode that bar it. A DMR decode is digital voice, so it only holds a file provisional, and the content check does not call TDMA buzz clearly not speech.

exceptions.name: noise-keyed-like-speech
exceptions.label: noise
exceptions.reason: An FM carrier whose audio is noise keyed like speech, on a channel with no digital prior: the content check runs only under a prior, and the keying passes the voice gate.

exceptions.name: fresh-dmr-reads-analog
exceptions.label: dmr
exceptions.reason: In the reference capture set, a DMR transmission that reads analog FM on a channel with no digital prior: its replay decode lands during the file, but a DMR decode only holds a file provisional and the audio does not measure clearly not speech, so it finishes as voice.
